about_the_game:
Is your RPG project in dire need of literal billions of colourful characters, and you have nor the time or skill to make them?

Fear not, the Hero Printer is here to help!

 

In the Hero Printer, one will find all that is necessary to build a plethora of RPG characters, from head to toes:

 

●     48x48  walking sprites;

●     7 base charset bodies to build upon;

●     4 directional animations;

●     6 frames loop version and 3 frames back and forth version;

●     3 frames version compatible with RPGMaker;

●     64x64 faceset sprites;

●     14 base faceset bodies to build upon;

●     Helmets, hats, crowns, capes, backpacks, shields, armor, tails, wings and much more;

●     Literal billions of possible combinations;

---------------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
